attchmntText: VIP Clothing Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: VIP Clothing Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board considered and approved the Un-Audited Financial Results for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026, along with the Limited Review Report. These documents are attached as Annexure A and are available on the company website at www.vipclothing.in. The meeting commenced at 03:45 P.M. IST and concluded at 5:30 P.M. IST. The announcement was issued by Mr. Rahul Soni, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.
